newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: McCollam details Format acquisition.
newsitem.headline: McCollam details Format acquisition.

text.p: McCollam Printers Ltd advised on Wednesday that it had settled the purchase of Format Publishers, a Wellington printing company.
The final acquisition price of NZ$14.474 million was for the business assets comprising plant and equipment, inventories, work in progress, debtors and goodwill.
"The vendors have retained responsibility for settling trade creditors," McCollam said.
The settlement was effected by the issue of 2.554 million McCollam shares at NZ$2.00 per share to vendors, the assumption of $5.529 million of liabilities and the balance in cash.
